description.text:
none: No transformation applied to input image.  Must be set to this when calculating track. Transform controls are set the same as match-move, but without actually applying a transform.

stabilize: Transforms the image so that the tracked points do not move.

stabilize 1-pt: Performs the same transform as stabilise, but locks the Transform filter to match the one used internally by the tracker. This is essential for getting perfectly stabilised tracks from 1-pt tracks. 

match-move: Transforms a different image so that it moves to match the tracked points.

match-move 1-pt: Performs the same transform as match-move, but locks the Transform filter to match the one used internally by the tracker. This will give better match-moves for 1-pt tracks. 

remove jitter: Transforms the image so that the tracked points move smoothly, with high-frequency removed.

add jitter: Transform the input image by the high-frequency components of the track, to increase the shake or to add it to another image.

+ To enable 'offset' tracking, ctrl+drag the tracker to a new position.
